thresholds.reference: A (Relume React control) at the same route/viewport
thresholds.semantic: score = 100% of SAC-expected roles present at every viewport AND role tree (tag, role, level, text) equal to A
thresholds.responsive: column counts and section padding-top equal to A at every sweep width (375..1440, 64px steps) and no horizontal overflow
thresholds.animation: translateY within 2 percentage points of column height of A at every probe sample; sticky stage = viewport (height == innerHeight, top == 0); reduced motion gives identity transform
thresholds.tokenIntegrity: C only: boundShare = 100% (every governed declaration uses var(--fs-*)) and 0 DSC token mismatches/missing
thresholds.visual: STRETCH: pixel mismatch <= 1% (pixelmatch threshold 0.1, includeAA false); SSIM and height difference reported
thresholds.accessibility: 0 serious or critical axe violations per route/viewport
thresholds.determinism: C only: pnpm generate:verify exit 0; generated files hash-equal to FROZEN.md; (bundle reproducibility reported separately)
thresholds.licence: C only: 0 matching lines >= 40 chars against Arm A reference source (supplementary, not proof); 0 forbidden-string hits
thresholds.fonts: Source Sans 3 face loaded (document.fonts) on every page
